summary: Iteration 6 — Full backend + frontend testing for Batch (c): Reports (10 types) + Workflows (W1..W5). Backend: 25/25 pytest pass (test_reports_workflows.py). Reports catalog + all 10 report detail endpoints return correct structure; bogus type returns 404. Workflows catalog + summary + full CRUD lifecycle per wtype (create→list→patch→toggle-step→complete→delete→404-on-bogus) all green. Completing all steps correctly flips status=complete/progress_pct=100; un-checking one reverts to in_progress. Regression (Batch b/a): /api/safety/*, /api/onboarding, /api/notifications all 200; Risk create with string likelihood/consequence still enriches correctly. Frontend: login + onboarding bypass via PUT /api/onboarding works. Sidebar shows nav-reports + all 5 nav-wf-* links (new-employee, incident-resolution, swms-to-job-start, annual-whs-review, subcontractor). /dashboard/reports renders all 10 report cards; dialog opens on click with Download JSON + Print buttons visible and compliance score pillars rendered. All 5 workflow routes mount their respective workflow-{wtype}-page container with add-btn. E2E on /dashboard/workflows/new-employee: filled title+entity, POST creates instance, card appears with 0%, 'Show steps' expands the 7-step checklist, clicking 'Worker profile created' toggled to 'IN PROGRESS / 14% · 1/7', delete removed the card and showed 'Removed' toast. Batch (b) Risk Register page still loads (regression OK).

issues: Testid for 'First Aid & PPE' link is computed as 'nav-first-aid--ppe' (double dash) because the regex strips '&' but keeps the surrounding '-'s — test selector expected 'nav-first-aid-and-ppe'. The link still navigates correctly; this is only a test-id hygiene issue. Pre-existing from Batch (b), not introduced in Batch (c). Suggested fix in DashboardLayout.jsx line 100: add .replace(/-+/g, '-') and .replace(/^-|-$/g, '') after the existing regex to collapse double-dashes.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:948-1118 Reports are computed on-the-fly from live collections with consistent shape {meta, generated_at, rows|counts|pillars} — good design, no ObjectId leakage (all queries use projection {_id:0}).

server.py:1124-1293 Workflows route order is correct: /workflows/catalog and /workflows/summary declared BEFORE /workflows/{wtype}, so FastAPI matches the literal paths first. Verified by pytest (catalog/summary return 200; bogus wtype returns 404 from _validate_workflow).

server.py:1178-1187 _workflow_progress() is pure and correct — round(done/total*100) matches the 14% observed for 1/7 steps. Status transitions (not_started → in_progress → complete and reverse) are all verified green.
server.py:1246 update_workflow() properly blacklists _id, user_id, instance_id, created_at, workflow_type from PATCH body — prevents tenant-id tampering. Good.
server.py:1288 delete_workflow returns {deleted: N} without 404 when nothing was deleted — acceptable but consider 404 for consistency with other resources.
Reports.jsx uses data-testid={`report-${r.type}-btn`} — verified selector compliance end-to-end (clicking compliance_score and incidents_trend opens the dialog).

WorkflowPage.jsx is cleanly parameterised by wtype and uses data-testid={`workflow-${wtype}-page|add-btn|submit-btn|f-title|f-entity|f-notes`} + per-instance testids workflow-card-{id}/expand-{id}/step-{id}-{key}/del-{id} — excellent testability.
